boundary.resolution: Sixteen slots, separate staging/captured-command/live-bank paths, actual installed system/selected-card ROM extents and one 512-KiB private RAM are defined; nonzero complete descriptors do not admit main RAM, card RAM or mailboxes. No ordinary CPU sample-RAM aperture is invented.

registers.resolution: All 60 word ports, 21+21 distinct parameter/reset banks, full fields and signed formats, special accepted queue/clock writes, nonadjacent fault ports and live effects are independently source-checked.

datapath.resolution: PCM8/PCM16 stereo layout and interpolation, BADP seek/block/nibble format with all 89 steps, signed Q16 phase/loops, square duty, signed Q12 mix/fade and Q14 biquad recurrence/history are taught with checked numerical examples and real mirrored output replay.

visibility.resolution: Command capture differs from execution and does not capture a cartridge socket; PLAY uses execution-time selection, retains bound storage across SELECT alone, and individually live source stores rebind using access-time selection. Selected reads/writes synchronize prior output. Transfer count/deadline are captured, pending address remains live, mode changes cancel, and same-cycle RAM commit precedes output.

timing.resolution: Installed 33,868,800 system cycles/s, 44,100 output frames/s, 768 cycles/frame and 1,058,400 transfer words/s/32 cycles per scheduled word are explicit. Controlled 20-word ROM upload reaches DMA DONE 680 and RAM commit 808 identically on both owners; electrical/end-to-end ratings are not fabricated. The appended download lesson supplies controlled 20-word 16+4 and short4-word schedules, surplus refill and STOP-before/exact-edge behavior, with separate actual-owner execution. CPU setup/polls are explicitly excluded from those device-work tables.

interrupts.resolution: Natural/faded ends clear banks and publish latest event/sequence before APU IRQ 20H; ascending multi-end overwrite and pending coalescence are explicit. Central acknowledgement, masked VBlank and predicate HALT waits are independently reviewed and actually exercised.

faults.resolution: Only actual BAD_CMD and SOURCE_RANGE emitters, first-fault retention/nonzero ACK/no fault IRQ, failed PLAY versus retained failed live write, and separate system access faults are source-checked. Metadata-validation guarantees are not inferred from unused declarations.

reset.resolution: APU reset clears RAM, queues, transfer/voice/event/fault/clock state, restores staging defaults and zeros selected banks. STOP_SLOT and transfer STOP are not global reset or RAM-clear commands; pending-batch cancellation is explicit.

programming.resolution: Complete two-module BIOS-style BLua uses existing central records, named readonly PCM/presets, BSS, actual asset symbols and preserved cartlib DMA/IRQ ownership. Ordinary guest execution checks four sound routes, all 16 transfer words, separate completions, four ends and zero faults; exact printed modules match source. Independent complete-reader review passes after the resource-name/metadata-producer clarifications. A separate complete 74-line raw-port BLua cartridge checks20-word and4-word downloads, all 24 destination words, exact count/DONE/masked pending and APU status snapshots with unchanged source lifetime. Fresh public-only extraction matches all 3 files; snapshots are not used as exact STOP timing proof.
